candidate_1.issuing_body: Parliament of the Republic of Ghana
candidate_1.title: Citizenship Act, 2000 (Act 591)
candidate_1.pdf_visual_examination: Web PDF screenshot index 0 (title/assent), 1 (section 7 begins, print p2), 2 (section 7 concludes, print p3). Original PDF includes third-party DataCenta typography/copyright; it is an official government-hosted reproduction, not independently proved signed Gazette facsimile.
candidate_1.original_statute_witness: Act 591 Part I, section 2 (period-indexed law restatement) and section 7 (persons born 7 January 1993 or after)
candidate_1.textual_proposition: The enacted text provides a citizenship-by-birth condition for persons born on/after 1993-01-07, within or outside Ghana, when the parent/grandparent citizenship predicate stated in section 7 holds at the person's birth. It is a legal rule class and not an observation of a particular person.
candidate_1.population: Birth cohort 1993-01-07 onward, people born inside or outside Ghana meeting the section 7 parent-or-grandparent citizenship predicate; NOT every resident nor every 2012 respondent
candidate_1.measurement_grain: One dated national statutory eligibility provision applying to a described legal subject class; no respondent row, registry of citizenship determinations, document issuance, enforcement or realized access

dates.gov_registry_date_disagreement: BRR HTML lists 2000-12-29 under 'Date of Gazette', conflicting with the last line of the government-hosted Act 591 PDF that says 2001-01-05. Do not silently reconcile.

candidate_2.title: The Constitution of the Republic of Ghana, 1992
candidate_2.page_reference: PDF viewer index 17, two-page printed spread pp. 5–6, Chapter Three Article 6(2); visually examined screenshot
candidate_2.textual_proposition: Subject to the Constitution, birth in or outside Ghana after Constitution entered into force confers citizenship from birth where one parent or grandparent is or was a citizen of Ghana.
candidate_2.population: People born after constitutional commencement with qualifying citizenship of a parent/grandparent
candidate_2.measurement_grain: Constitutional eligibility rule; independent of survey attitudes or person-level enforcement outcomes
candidate_2.version_warning: Scanned original includes pre-1996 Article 8 dual-citizenship text; do not treat this scan as a complete up-to-date consolidated constitutional law edition. Article 6(2) is crosschecked with statute section 7 only at their exact common proposition.
not_verified: actual citizenship award, proof or adjudication

combination.claim_equivalence: Article 6(2) and Act 591 section 7 support the overlapping parent/grandparent birth-citizenship legal rule at text grain; law hierarchy and temporal scope must not be silently erased.
combination.cannot_be_joint_risk: No shared measured respondent rows or compatible persons; independent legal norm and survey attitude are different objects.
combination.science_precondition: Doc historical veracity is not model source/producer issuance or actual enforcement.
